Title: Annual average loss (AAL)
Description: Expected loss per year averaged over the full loss exceedance probability curve. impact_type denotes total

Title: Probable maximum loss (PML)
Description: Estimated maximum loss at a given exceedance probability or return period, assuming normal functioning of passive protective features.

Title: Value at risk (VaR)
Description: Minimum loss likely to be equalled or exceeded at a given annual probability.

Title: Tail value at risk (TVaR)
Description: Average loss conditional on exceeding the value at risk threshold.
